_note: The predefined intent catalogue. Single source: Spike S-3 tests it, and memory/product/design/intent-catalogue.md is rendered from it. At build time this file becomes the app's flow file (spec FR18). All Thai is a draft for the owner to correct. Example phrases are the TEST SET, not training data — Jev is not trained; it reads each intent's `description`.
default_shop_said: มีอะไรให้แอดช่วยอีกไหมคะ?
intent_question: A customer is chatting with Beanly, an online coffee bean shop. `shop_said` is the shop's last message and `customer_said` is the customer's reply. Which one of these intents best describes what the customer wants in `customer_said`? Choose none if no intent fits.

ask_brew.set_when: the bot has asked how the customer brews

ask_roast.set_when: the bot has asked which roast the customer likes

options_shown.set_when: the bot has just listed two to four products
options_shown.note: No separate position entity: S-3 run 1 showed the product question resolves 'ตัวแรก', 'อันหลัง' against shop_said by itself.
options_shown.params: {skus: [...]} — a pick is checked against the list actually shown

offer_product.set_when: the bot has shown one product and asked whether the customer will take it
offer_product.params: {sku} — “เอาค่ะ” takes this product even when Jev returns not_mentioned

ask_quantity.set_when: the bot has asked how many bags
ask_quantity.params: {sku} — “2 ถุง” sets the quantity of this line

offer_promo.set_when: the bot has offered a promotion and asked whether the customer wants it
offer_promo.params: {promo_id, effect} — “สนใจค่ะ” applies exactly what was offered

ask_payment.set_when: the bot has asked how the customer will pay

ask_delivery.set_when: the bot has asked for a name, address and phone number

confirm_order.set_when: the bot has read the order back and asked the customer to confirm
confirm_order.params: {order_hash} — “ยืนยันค่ะ” confirms the order that was read out; if it changed since, it is read back again

events.welcome: The page opens, or the conversation starts over → the `greet` response and its buttons. No model call.
events.button_click: A button fires its intent directly, with its values already known (the 2 ถุง button is `inform` with quantity 2). No model call. The click is echoed as the customer's own message.
events.use_sample_details: The ใช้ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง button under `ask_delivery` → `give_delivery_details` with a fixed fictional name, address and phone.
